author: root
body: Root contract resolution after red/falsifier review: implement only one exact profile in inequality-direction-v2: each reading is `∀ x : Nat, x ≤ 0` or `∀ x : Nat, 0 ≤ x`, with the same source binder ID and exact known numeral `0`; both sides must use opposite operand order. This avoids pretending general order-instance semantics are available. Native contract records use the existing validated schema, identical profile/endpoint/context/conclusion/feature metadata, empty assumptions, exact one-binder Nat telescope, unknown out-of-scope regularity/constant metadata, no witness dependencies; endpoint and conclusion are both `relation:Nat.le`. Exact selected application type is checked by the formal-reading goal against the right reading; all goals remain open and no authority is granted. Matching control is left-to-right implication `∀x, x≤0 → ∀x, 0≤x`, a valid Nat consequence; discrepancy is right-to-left counterexample `∀x,0≤x ∧ ¬(∀x,x≤0)`. Reject all other relations, constants, operands, domains and contract drift; retain v1 unsupported. The test author’s compact pseudo-contract is not accepted as contract evidence because it does not match `validate_contract`; root will replace it with real native artifacts and freeze only the root-reviewed failing regression. No new dependency; 8 MiB limit and existing shared deadline/12 GiB cap apply.

author: /root/inequality_integrated_audit
body: Independent read-only integrated audit found one issue: arbitrary equal order contexts passed because only domainId Nat was checked. Disposition: accepted. Fix by exact allowlisted built-in Nat order context and add regression; see reviewer message delivered to root.

author: root
body: Resolution of finding #799: accepted. Tightened `_context_error` to an exact allowlist for object:nat-order, domain:Nat, scale:none, representation:original, matching the documented built-in Nat order profile. Added five field-mutation checks and a same-custom-context probe-planner regression. Auditor re-reviewed the fix and reported no further actionable issues. Source-bound qualification passed four accepted Lean goals: checked local counterexample plus valid left-to-right implication control. No prose-fidelity or paper-error claim.
